description: Play ViZDoom's take_cover scenario: monsters on the far wall throw fireballs at you, and more monsters appear over time. You can only strafe. You earn 1 per tic alive, and the episode ends at death or after 2100 tics. Fireballs appear in objects; move out of their path. Each step the graph receives an observation, and its label output is the next action. In the observation, objects lists what is visible: x is the object's horizontal screen position from -1 (left edge) to 1 (right edge), y is vertical from -1 (top) to 1 (bottom), and width and height are fractions of the screen, so nearer objects are larger. variables holds game variables. MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT strafe sideways, which shifts objects on screen the opposite way.
